system.echo.label: Local echo test
system.echo.effect: Return the submitted message unchanged through the local intent and evidence path.
system.echo.provider: No external provider; the verified built-in echo tool is used.
system.echo.destination: The local Sandbox service on this node.
system.echo.information_scope: The message text and stated purpose only.
system.echo.cost: No external service cost or settlement.
system.echo.retention: The returned message is retained in the encrypted local intent result and integrity-linked evidence remains append-only.
system.echo.cancellation: Cancel stops the browser from waiting. The node may already have completed, so recovery must reuse the same request key.
system.echo.reversibility: There is no external side effect. The append-only local evidence record is not removed by this preview.

memory.put.label: Create a private memory record
memory.put.effect: Create one content-addressed memory record owned by the authenticated local principal.
memory.put.provider: No external provider; the verified built-in memory validator is used.
memory.put.destination: The encrypted local Grid store on this node.
memory.put.information_scope: The selected record kind, title, note text, and fixed AXIOM One source marker only.
memory.put.cost: No external service cost or settlement.
memory.put.retention: The active record remains encrypted on this node until it is tombstoned; integrity-linked evidence remains append-only.
memory.put.cancellation: Cancel stops the browser from waiting. The node may already have completed, so recovery must reuse the same request key.
memory.put.reversibility: The record can be tombstoned, but this preview cannot erase its append-only evidence or restore a tombstoned record.

memory.link.label: Record a private provenance link
memory.link.effect: Create one owner-bound directional provenance edge between two exact active memory records.
memory.link.provider: No external provider; the verified built-in memory validator is used.
memory.link.destination: The encrypted local Grid store on this node.
memory.link.information_scope: The exact source and target object identifiers, one displayed relationship, and the fixed AXIOM One source marker only.
memory.link.cost: No external service cost or settlement.
memory.link.retention: The active encrypted edge remains until either linked object is tombstoned; its integrity-linked evidence remains append-only.
memory.link.cancellation: Cancel stops the browser from waiting. The node may already have completed, so recovery must reuse the same request key.
memory.link.reversibility: This preview cannot delete an edge directly. Tombstoning either linked object removes the edge from active Vault results but does not erase evidence.

memory.tombstone.label: Tombstone a private memory record
memory.tombstone.effect: Remove one exact owned active memory record and its links from active Vault results.
memory.tombstone.provider: No external provider; the verified built-in memory validator is used.
memory.tombstone.destination: The encrypted local Grid store on this node.
memory.tombstone.information_scope: The exact memory object identifier and the displayed owner-removal reason only.
memory.tombstone.cost: No external service cost or settlement.
memory.tombstone.retention: The record is marked tombstoned rather than physically erased; its encrypted row and integrity-linked evidence remain for audit and recovery controls outside this preview.
memory.tombstone.cancellation: Cancel stops the browser from waiting. The node may already have completed, so recovery must reuse the same request key.
memory.tombstone.reversibility: This preview has no restore action. Recovery requires separately governed backup or import procedures and is not promised.

export.create.label: Create a selective local memory export
export.create.effect: Create one export containing only the selected owned memory object plus the kernel-required identity and evidence records.
export.create.provider: No external provider; the verified built-in export validator is used.
export.create.destination: A local export bundle on this node; AXIOM One fetches it only after a separate reveal action.
export.create.information_scope: The exact selected memory object identifier, required identity record, and integrity evidence only.
export.create.cost: No external service cost or settlement.
export.create.retention: The generated bundle remains in the node export directory; this preview has no export-deletion control.
export.create.cancellation: Cancel stops the browser from waiting. The node may already have completed, so recovery must reuse the same request key.
export.create.reversibility: Creating an export does not alter the source record, but this preview cannot delete a generated bundle.

authentication_required.title: Connection required
authentication_required.summary: The Gateway did not authenticate this request.
authentication_required.next_step: Reconnect with a current local token before trying again.

invalid_token.title: Token not accepted
invalid_token.summary: The supplied local token is invalid, expired, or retired.
invalid_token.next_step: Clear it, obtain a current local token, and reconnect.

forbidden.title: Authority denied
forbidden.summary: The authenticated principal does not have authority for this request.
forbidden.next_step: Do not work around the denial. Review the principal and required scope.

rate_limited.title: Request rate limited
rate_limited.summary: The Gateway rejected this request before the intent handler ran.
rate_limited.next_step: Wait, then retry the unchanged request with the same request key.

body_too_large.title: Request too large
body_too_large.summary: The request exceeded the fixed byte limit and was not accepted.
body_too_large.next_step: Reduce the input before creating a new reviewed request.

validation_error.title: Request not valid
validation_error.summary: The request did not satisfy the active input contract.
validation_error.next_step: Review the visible fields and create a corrected request.

not_found.title: Requested route unavailable
not_found.summary: The exact contract route or record was not found.
not_found.next_step: Check the current build and route contract; do not infer success.

idempotency_conflict.title: Request key conflict
idempotency_conflict.summary: This request key was already bound to different request content.
idempotency_conflict.next_step: Do not overwrite the earlier binding. Inspect its receipt before creating a new reviewed request.

confirmation_required.title: Explicit confirmation required
confirmation_required.summary: Policy stopped execution until its exact confirmation value is supplied.
confirmation_required.next_step: Review the requested effect and confirmation value. This preview does not add it automatically.

independent_approval_required.title: Independent approval required
independent_approval_required.summary: Policy stopped execution until a different principal approves this exact request digest.
independent_approval_required.next_step: Use a separately authenticated approval workflow. This preview cannot self-approve.

approval_mismatch.title: Approval does not match
approval_mismatch.summary: The supplied approval was not active and bound to this exact requester, action, and request digest.
approval_mismatch.next_step: Inspect the approval record; never substitute or widen it.

approval_unavailable.title: Approval unavailable
approval_unavailable.summary: The one-use approval was expired, consumed, or otherwise unavailable.
approval_unavailable.next_step: Obtain a new independently granted approval for the exact request.

policy_denied.title: Policy denied the action
policy_denied.summary: The active deny-dominant policy did not authorize execution.
policy_denied.next_step: Treat the denial as authoritative; do not retry to bypass it.

capability_unavailable.title: Capability unavailable
capability_unavailable.summary: This build has no verified provider or adapter for the requested capability.
capability_unavailable.next_step: Do not simulate the missing capability or present it as completed.

dependency_unavailable.title: Outcome not confirmed
dependency_unavailable.summary: The browser could not confirm whether the local node received or completed the request.
dependency_unavailable.next_step: Retry the unchanged request with the same request key so the node can recover an existing result safely.

request_cancelled.title: Waiting cancelled; outcome not confirmed
request_cancelled.summary: Cancellation stopped the browser wait, but it cannot revoke work the node may already have completed.
request_cancelled.next_step: Retry the unchanged request with the same request key to recover the authoritative result.

request_timeout.title: Timed out; outcome not confirmed
request_timeout.summary: The bounded browser wait ended before an authoritative result arrived.
request_timeout.next_step: Retry the unchanged request with the same request key; do not create a duplicate request.

response_too_large.title: Result exceeded the display boundary
response_too_large.summary: The client rejected an oversized response and cannot safely claim the final outcome.
response_too_large.next_step: Inspect the intent through a bounded operator workflow; this preview will not display or retry the oversized result.

invalid_client_request.title: Browser request blocked
invalid_client_request.summary: The client rejected the request before network I/O because it did not match the exact contract.
invalid_client_request.next_step: Create a corrected reviewed request; do not bypass client validation.

invalid_gateway_response.title: Gateway result could not be verified
invalid_gateway_response.summary: A response arrived but did not match the exact client contract, so no outcome is claimed.
invalid_gateway_response.next_step: Retry the unchanged request with the same request key and inspect the raw trace if it recurs.

active.title: Approval active
active.summary: A different principal granted one-use authority for one exact request until the listed expiry.

consumed.title: Approval already used
consumed.summary: This one-use approval was consumed by the listed intent and cannot authorize another request.

expired.title: Approval expired
expired.summary: The approval is past its bound expiry and cannot authorize execution.

unknown.title: Approval state not understood
unknown.summary: The raw approval record is available, but this preview cannot safely interpret its state.

accounting.account.created: A local accounting identity was recorded.
accounting.journal.posted: A balanced local accounting journal was committed.
approval.consumed: A bound independent approval was consumed by one intent.
approval.granted: A separate principal approved one exact request until expiry.
backup.completed: An encrypted backup completed and its manifest was recorded.
backup.requested: A governed backup request entered the evidence log.
backup.restored: A governed restore completed and was recorded.
capsule.registered: A validated capsule manifest was admitted to the local registry.
capsule.revoked: The capsule was revoked and is no longer active.
consent.granted: A purpose-, scope-, subject-, controller-, and expiry-bound consent record was created.
consent.revoked: The consent record was revoked and no longer authorizes new use.
export.completed: A governed export bundle completed and its evidence was recorded.
export.requested: A scoped local export request entered the evidence log.
governance.activated: A finalized governance proposal became active after its timelock.
governance.appeal.filed: A governance appeal was recorded for review.
governance.emergency.activated: A temporary authority-reducing emergency policy became active until expiry.
governance.emergency.reviewed: The emergency governance action received its required review record.
governance.finalized: Voting closed and the governance outcome was finalized.
governance.proposed: A governance proposal was recorded for voting.
governance.rolled-back: A governed policy activation was rolled back to its recorded predecessor.
governance.verified: A governance activation received its verification record.
governance.voted: A chamber vote was added to the proposal record.
import.applied: An independently approved import was applied to the foreign-record store.
import.staged: An import bundle was validated and staged without applying it.
intent.accepted: The node recorded the request before policy evaluation reached a final outcome.
intent.completed: Execution completed and the result was committed to local evidence.
intent.denied: Policy, confirmation, or approval requirements stopped execution.
intent.failed: The node recorded a failure; inspect the raw event before inferring whether any partial work occurred.
memory.linked: A provenance edge between governed memory objects was recorded.
memory.put: An encrypted owner-bound memory object was recorded.
memory.tombstoned: The memory object was marked unavailable while append-only provenance remained.
node.quarantined: The admitted node was removed from eligible scheduling.
node.registered: A signed node statement was admitted to the local registry.
node.renewed: An admitted node statement and lease were renewed.
node.schedule.requested: A signed bounded scheduling request was recorded.
storage.offered: A bounded storage-capacity offer was recorded without transferring content.
sync.bundle.applied: An independently approved causal bundle was applied with its conflict state visible.

unknown_event.title: Unmapped evidence event
unknown_event.summary: The exact event kind and raw record are available, but this preview makes no plain-language claim about it.
